violation_type.title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §744.2507(5))
violation_type.short_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner
violation_type.typical_finding: There are several pieces of garbage on the playground area.

finding_variants.text: There are several pieces of garbage on the playground area.

One classroom had garbage accessible to children as the trash can in the classroom contained garbage inside of it and did not have a lid or cover.  This was corrected when the staff removed the trash can from the classroom.

I observed a school-age child placing their hands in the garbage can and rolling the garbage can with wheel around the cafeteria area.  Gargage accessible to children and rolling the gargae can around pose a risk to the health and safety of children. The child stopped placing their hands inside of the trash can and stopped rolling the trash can around in the cafeteria when management intervene.

Four classrooms had garbage accessible to children as the trash cans contained garbage in them and did not have a lid on them.  This was corrected when all four trash cans were removed from the classrooms.
The garbage trash container was not covered, garbage was accesible to children in care.
Two live ant beds were observed on the playground.
